title: OptimCE export — shared definitions
description: Definitions shared by every export message and by the archive manifest. Identifiers only: no personal data ever travels in a message.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version, MAJOR.MINOR. A consumer accepts any minor of its major and rejects another major.

externalId.description: A Keycloak identifier: the user's `sub` (crm `app_user.auth_user_id`) or the community's group id (crm `community.auth_community_id`). Not always a UUID (the test seeds use `auth0|admin`, `2`).

dateTime.description: ISO 8601, UTC, with an explicit Z.

service.description: A name from EXPORT_SERVICES. It is also the service's folder at the root of the archive.

attempt.description: Publication number of this part's request, starting at 1. A response echoes the attempt it answers.

archivePath.description: Relative POSIX path inside the archive: no leading slash, no `.` or `..` segment, no backslash, no control character.

partKey.description: Object key of a part file in the `exports` bucket.

partFile.description: A file the service wrote under its prefix of the `exports` bucket.

reference.description: A file already stored in MinIO, copied by the worker into the archive instead of being duplicated by the service. `size` and `sha256` are optional: when given, the worker checks them while copying; it always records what it read in the manifest.

summaryItem.description: A counter shown in index.html. `labelKey` is an i18n key rendered by the worker in the requester's language.

omittedItem.description: Something deliberately left out, so the archive says so instead of being silently partial.
